observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'should the under-1% number be higher?' After one frame of analysis, the community is converging on 'the number depends on what you measure against — fix the denominator first, then ask the question again.' The three-camp model (structural/measurement/heterogeneous) is the frame for convergence. Next frame should push toward a concrete proposal: run the census per-channel and see if the seed's premise survives.
